action: Freeze new feature state in Run.h; move subsystem state behind owners.

current_problem: Constructor wires almost the whole engine graph and seeds subsystem policy.
action: Keep construction here but move policy initialization into subsystem bootstrap APIs.

current_problem: Binds a broad mutable view over Run-owned systems.
action: Split EngineContext into narrow process/world/runtime views or remove consumers row by row.

current_problem: Run builds presentation diagnostics directly from engine context.
action: Move remaining per-feature snapshot filling behind presentation/diagnostics owners.

current_problem: Run owns ordered GPU-resource release behavior.
action: Move release order into renderer/resource lifecycle owner; Run delegates one call.

current_problem: Asset registration lives in Run instead of asset bootstrap.
action: Move built-in source asset registration into AssetSystem bootstrap with explicit render rebuild hook.

current_problem: Scene lifecycle reaches into replay reset policy.
action: Make scene reset emit a replay lifecycle command consumed by ReplayRuntime.

current_problem: Replay restore behavior remains a Run-side mutation path.
action: Move solver sample application behind replay/physics restore service with store handles.

current_problem: Scene load still performs broad runtime/world/model/render side effects.

current_problem: Input routing directly mutates camera UI replay editor diagnostics and scene commands.

current_problem: Run applies queued runtime/tool commands directly.
action: Move command application into dispatcher with explicit subsystem command handlers.

current_problem: Camera/tool mode transitions remain Run behavior.
action: Make interaction controller own transition cleanup and camera mode commands.

current_problem: Attached camera behavior lives in Run input file.
action: Move attach target resolve/orbit/follow into controller consuming body/render snapshots.

current_problem: Post-step hooks mix physics audio replay diagnostics and presentation side effects.
action: Create ordered post-step pipeline with owner-specific hooks.

current_problem: Frame simulation policy is still Run-side orchestration plus behavior.

current_problem: Screenshot command remains Run behavior.

current_problem: Run packages render-facing model frame view.
action: Move frame snapshot build into RuntimeRenderer or render snapshot builder.

current_problem: Run still owns render entry policy before RuntimeRenderer.

current_problem: Run rebuilds render resources from assets.

current_problem: Replay branch restore lives in Run inline tooling.

current_problem: Replay scrubber input remains Run behavior.

current_problem: Replay cause tree input remains Run behavior.

current_problem: Replay velocity edit input mutates through Run.

current_problem: Replay visualization remains Run render-tool behavior.

current_problem: Stress actions mutate UI/runtime from Run.
action: Move stress action policies into deterministic harness services.

current_problem: Graphics stress mutates scene/render policy from Run.
action: Move graphics stress actions to harness that emits runtime commands.
